contracts: The exact C# case starts real owned queue/running work under existing APIs, closes ordinary production responsibility through the controlled-stop path and invokes existing authorized cancellation. Verify token/queue/run transitions and denial of out-of-scope or policy-blocked cancellation; no new hot-role protocol or longer bound is introduced. Python must invoke the exact C# test through dotnet test and validate one fresh TRX result plus actual product observations. Compile failures, missing APIs/types/tests, skips, missing/invalid TRX or timeout are harness failures, never expected-red. All owners are existing public entrypoint files; do not pre-seed a missing C# production class to obtain RED. No product runtime success is claimed by this plan.
